calibration.definition: the greatest level L such that ACC(level) >= 0.80 for every level <= L on the calibration pool

checks.V0_slot_identity: the slot answers /v1/models and NIGHTLY_MODEL_ID is non-empty before any prompt (issue #200)
checks.V1_solver_certified: the judge's BFS gold flips to no when the first hop of a yes item is removed
checks.V2_pool_balance: every level reports its gold share and majority-class accuracy, so no 0.80 read is reported without its chance
checks.V3_gate_measured: the #67 permutation-calibrated leak gate runs on exactly this pool and every per-level status is recorded
checks.V4_prompt_clean: no built prompt carries the gold token
checks.V5_delivery_census: every record carries a frozen DELIVERY_STATES value and the message-field census (issue #105); a cap-exhausted record is not_delivered, not a miss (issue #145)

decision.no_mastery_case: if no level reaches 0.80 then d_hat = 0 and the accuracy floor is reported (rule.json no_mastery_case)
decision.reported: d_hat over the dispatched census, intent to treat (every dispatched item stays in n)
decision.underpowered: n=8 per level, below min_n_exploratory 40: report the Wilson interval and the majority baseline beside every level accuracy, never the point estimate alone
decision.worthless_if: level accuracy is driven by censoring, extraction failure or a surface leak rather than by depth, or if the endpoint identity moves mid-run
